name: Run
about: A deployment, training run or live evaluation, done by an agent
labels: [ready, run]

**Module:** run · **Size:** S · **Blocked by:** #n, #m or – · **Labels:** ready, run

**Context.** Why this run, with links to the sections of docs/plan.md it implements.

**What.** The exact commands, in order, including starting and stopping any deployment.

**Credentials.** Which keys or environments the machine needs. No key appears in the issue or in a pull request.

**Cost cap.** The amount and the bucket of docs/plan.md, Compute, it is paid from.

**Done when.**

- [ ] Run IDs, results and spend are recorded, and results are merged through a pull request.
